connections.untrained: Wannan aiki ya yi amfani da ayyukan Google, kuma bayanansu suna zuwa ne kawai ga ƙwaƙwalwa da ba sa taɓa amfani da su wajen horar da AI. Zaɓi ɗaya, ko ƙara ɗaya.
connections.keyHint: Sai idan aikin ya ba ka makulli. In ba haka ba, za a ce ka shiga.
connections.failed: Ba a iya haɗawa ba. Duba adireshin: wasu ayyuka ba sa karɓar haɗi daga mai bincike tukuna.
connections.needsKey: Wannan aikin yana bukatar ka shiga, ko makulli.
connections.failedKnown: Ba a iya haɗawa da {service} ba. Sake gwadawa nan da ɗan lokaci.
gateway.title: Ƙofar shiga
gateway.text: Wasu ayyuka ba sa karɓar haɗi daga mai bincike tukuna. Ana iya isa gare su ta ƙofar shiga da ƙungiyarku ko ku kuke tafiyarwa: shigar da adireshinta a nan.
connections.lede: Shafin kowanne yana faɗin abin da aka yarda a yi a can.
connections.reads.allow: Karantawa ba tare da tambaya ba
connections.acts.allow: Aiwatarwa ba tare da tambaya ba
connections.may: Abin da aka yarda a yi a {service}
connections.usual: Idan ba ka zaɓi komai a nan ba, dokokin Amincewa ne ke aiki, kamar a kowane aiki.
connections.guarded: Amincewa na da doka mafi tsauri ga {service}, wadda ke gaba.
connections.trains: Abin da {service} ya kawo yana zuwa ne kawai ga ƙwaƙwalwa da ba sa taɓa horo da shi.
connections.disconnectAsk: Cire haɗin {service}? Makullinsa zai bar wannan na’ura; babu abin da zai canza a cikin {service} kansa.
connections.later: Ba daga mai bincike ba tukuna

connections.laterCount.one: Ƙarin {count}, ba daga mai bincike ba tukuna
connections.laterCount.other: Ƙarin {count}, ba daga mai bincike ba tukuna

connections.laterText: Ta hanyar ƙofa, wadda ƙungiyarka ko kai ke gudanarwa
connections.otherText: Don aikin da babu a jerin. Adireshinsa yana zuwa daga aikin ko daga ƙungiyarka.
connections.can: Abin da za a yarda a yi a can
connections.signInThere: Idan {service} ya tambaya, za ka shiga a can, sannan ka dawo nan. Ba a taɓa ganin kalmar sirrinka a nan ba.
connections.sealed: Makullinsa yana zama a wannan na’ura a rufe, kuma ba ya taɓa shiga ajiya, fitarwa ko rabawa.
connections.another: An riga an haɗa {service}: wannan zai ƙara wani asusu.
